data.title: Health insurer rejects taxi travel cost request
data.summary: Beispiel Ersatzkasse wrote on 25 June 2025 rejecting your application of 10 June 2025 to cover taxi costs to outpatient physiotherapy. You can object within one month of notification.
data.explanation: Your health insurer refuses to pay for taxi rides to physiotherapy. Such costs are only covered in exceptional cases, for example care level 3 with permanently limited mobility, or the marks aG, Bl or H in a severe disability card (§ 60 SGB V). The insurer says you don't meet these conditions. If you think the decision is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch), in writing or recorded in person; the app shows the deadline. If you don't object in time, the decision becomes final. Consider advice if your situation includes any of the listed conditions.

items.title: File objection (Widerspruch)

date.text: innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection in writing or recorded in person with Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
items.consequence: The rejection becomes final if you do not object in time.
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
